meta.purpose: Unified discovery catalog for ontology expansion

nodes.label: Gross Margin %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Gross Profit / Revenue x 100

nodes.label: Operating Margin %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Operating Income / Revenue x 100

nodes.label: Net Margin %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Net Income / Revenue x 100

nodes.label: EBIT (approx)
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Net Income + Interest + Tax

nodes.label: Current Ratio
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Current Assets / Current Liabilities

nodes.label: Quick Ratio
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: (Current Assets - Inventory) / Current Liabilities

nodes.label: Cash Ratio
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Cash / Current Liabilities

nodes.label: Debt-to-Equity
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Total Liabilities / Total Equity

nodes.label: Debt/Total Capital
nodes.expression: (ST Debt + LT Debt) / (ST Debt + LT Debt + Equity)
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: (ST Debt + LT Debt) / (ST Debt + LT Debt + Equity)

nodes.label: Equity Ratio %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Total Equity / Total Assets x 100

nodes.label: Interest Coverage
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: EBIT (standard) / Interest Expense

nodes.label: Net Debt
nodes.expression: ST Debt + LT Debt + Lease Liabilities - Cash
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: ST Debt + LT Debt + Lease Liabilities - Cash

nodes.label: Net Debt/EBITDA
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Financial Net Debt / EBITDA (standard)

nodes.label: Lease Liabilities Ratio %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: (Operating + Finance Leases) / Total Assets x 100

nodes.label: Cash from Operations
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Operating Cash Flow

nodes.label: Cash Flow Coverage
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: OCF / Current Liabilities

nodes.label: Fixed Charge Coverage
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: (EBIT + Lease Expense) / (Interest + Lease Expense)

nodes.label: ROE %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Net Income / Total Equity x 100

nodes.label: ROA %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Net Income / Total Assets x 100

nodes.label: Accruals Ratio
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: (Net Income - OCF) / Total Assets

nodes.label: Earnings Quality
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: OCF / Net Income

nodes.label: Sloan Accrual
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: (ΔWC - ΔCash - D&A) / Avg Total Assets

nodes.label: Intangible Ratio %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Intangible Assets / Total Assets x 100

nodes.label: Goodwill Ratio %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Goodwill / Total Assets x 100

nodes.label: Tangible Equity
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Total Equity - Intangibles - Goodwill

nodes.label: P/E Ratio
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Price / Diluted EPS

nodes.label: P/B Ratio
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Market Cap / Total Equity

nodes.label: EV/EBITDA
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Enterprise Value / EBITDA

nodes.label: Cash Conversion Cycle
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: DSO + DIO - DPO

nodes.label: NOPAT
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Operating Income x (1 - Tax Rate)

nodes.label: Invested Capital
nodes.expression: Equity + ST Debt + LT Debt - Cash
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Equity + ST Debt + LT Debt - Cash

nodes.label: ROIC %
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: NOPAT / Invested Capital x 100

nodes.label: Asset Turnover
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Revenue / Total Assets

nodes.label: Piotroski F-Score
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: 9 binary fundamental tests (0-9)

nodes.label: Altman Z-Score
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Bankruptcy probability model

nodes.label: Beneish M-Score
nodes.definition: edgar_analytics derived metric: Earnings manipulation probability model
